verity.description: Verity LLM confidence scoring layer — score, verify, and triage any LLM response

tools.name: score_response
tools.description: Score an LLM response for source grounding, factual consistency, claim specificity risk, and hedging calibration. Returns a full ScorecardResult with HITL recommendation.

tools.name: extract_claims
tools.description: Decompose an LLM response into atomic verifiable claims with metadata.

tools.name: get_hitl_decision
tools.description: Given a ScorecardResult, return the HITL decision (ACCEPT / REFINE / REJECT / ESCALATE) and an optional refinement prompt.
